QUOTE: "Those start at `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC`/`_FREE`, which default to `calloc`/`free` if libc is present, otherwise to stubs (`platform.c:24-42`). Stubs return NULL and do nothing."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the default stubs used when no allocator is configured return NULL (calloc) and do nothing (free), which is the item's substance.
